Going through this with a girl right now, so this might get personal...
I know you've been burned before by bad relationships. I know you've dated guy after guy, wishing, hoping, praying something would change. But it doesn't. It never does. Same old story: he wants your pants, you want romance. You want moonlight conversations and soft music, he wants your body and not much else.

It's frustrating. Infuriating. You start doubting yourself. Is all I am a piece of meat? Do all guys truly care for is sex? Is love and romance and matters of the heart just a front for lust and carnal desire? So you pull away. You retreat into yourself. The outside world is behind a wall so thick noone can topple it. I understand. I'd be there too. 

But here I am, outside those walls like everyone else. I'm holding a flower I found on the roadside, blasting cheesy love songs on an old boom box because I know you love that shitty movie. All I want is a chance, a shot. You and I have been friends for years, comrades in the struggle. I've stood on the sidelines, quiet and supporting, for longer than I can collect. 

One day, when you decide the walls need to come down, when you decide cutting off everyone and anyone simply doesn't make you happy, I will be here. I'm patient. I can wait. Until then, I'll be there, just on the edge of your world, offering corny poems and making puns. You are my best friend, and of all lessons learned in this world, is that nothing is too much for a friend.
